observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the same white computerized sewing and embroidery machine sitting on a striped bedsheet on a black leather sofa.
The word 'brother' is printed clearly on the front of the arm in both photos.

Blue right-hand panel with a white floral print, a small colour LCD screen and touch buttons; small model lettering above the screen in photo 1 reads as SE6x0, consistent with SE630, but it is too small to confirm every digit.
An embroidery unit is attached to the free arm in both photos, so this is a combination sewing and embroidery machine, not a plain sewing machine.
Both photos carry a 'Posted on Jiji' stamp and a dealer watermark 'ABIOLA...MACHINE'; photo 0 and photo 1 are the same scene from nearly the same angle.
Screen is lit in both photos, showing an image, so the machine was powered at least once; no power cord, foot pedal, hoops, accessories box or manual are visible.
No rating plate, serial label or country-of-origin label is shown.
Body looks clean, no visible cracks or yellowing at this resolution.

read_from: photo 1 panel lettering above screen: SE6x0, consistent with SE630 but small

claims.claim: Brother SE630 computerized sewing and embroidery machine
claims.evidence: Brand 'brother' readable in photo 0 and photo 1; blue floral panel, colour LCD and embroidery unit match the SE6x0 family. The last digits of the model are not sharp, so a close-up of the model label would make it certain.

No rating plate or origin label in either photo. Brother is a Japanese brand but this home line is commonly built in Southeast Asia; the plate on the back or underside would settle it. Does not change the price.
Screen is lit, but no clip of the machine stitching or embroidering.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: Only the embroidery unit is visible. No hoop, presser feet, foot pedal, power cord, bobbins or manual are shown.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Service history cannot be shown in a photo.

risks.risk: Sewing or embroidery function faulty (motor, needle bar, embroidery carriage not moving, touch screen dead)
risks.proof: One continuous clip: power on, select a design on the touch screen, embroidery carriage moves and stitches a few lines in the hoop, then a straight stitch run without the embroidery unit.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, parts value only

risks.risk: Missing embroidery hoop, foot pedal, power cord, presser feet and manual
risks.proof: One photo of every accessory laid out next to the machine, including the hoop, foot controller and power cord.
risks.if_unproven: as machine and embroidery unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Model is a different or older member of the SE6x0 family
risks.proof: Close-up of the model lettering on the panel and the rating plate on the back.
risks.if_unproven: as the cheapest machine of the SE6x0 family

risks.risk: Photos are dealer listing photos with a Jiji stamp and watermark, so the seller may not hold this exact unit
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the machine with a handwritten note of today's date and the seller's name beside it.
risks.if_unproven: condition taken as worst case; agent inspects before money moves

risks.risk: Screen scratches, cracked casing or worn feed dogs not visible at this resolution
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the screen, the needle plate and the underside.
risks.if_unproven: as fair condition with cosmetic wear

proof_requests: Clip: power on, select a design, embroidery unit stitches a few lines, then a short straight stitch run.
Close-up of the model label on the panel and the rating plate with serial number.
Photo of all accessories laid out: hoop, foot pedal, power cord, presser feet, bobbins, manual.
Fresh photo with a handwritten note of today's date beside the machine.
Close-ups of the screen, needle plate and underside.
response.reason: Brand Brother is readable in both photos and the panel, screen and embroidery unit place it in the SE6x0 sewing and embroidery family, so it can be priced at worst case as not working with no accessories. A working clip, accessories photo and model label would raise it.
